story.fullStory:
Toby Keith's "Beers Ago" reached #52 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Beers Ago" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Toby Keith.

The song peaked at #52 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Beers Ago was released in 2011.

"Beers Ago" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Toby Keith.
It was released in March 2012 as the third and final single from his 2011 album Clancy's Tavern.
Keith co-wrote the song with Bobby Pinson.
Clancy's Tavern is the seventeenth studio album by American country music artist Toby Keith.
It was released on October 25, 2011, by Show Dog-Universal Music.
Lead-off single "Made in America" was released on June 13, 2011, reaching number one on the country charts in October 2011.
